functions.name: TimeRangeToNumberRange
functions.docs: Convert a frame time range to a frame number range comprising all the frame numbers traversed in the range

functions.name: NumberRangeToTimeRange
functions.docs: Convert a frame number range to a frame time range

functions.name: GetRange
functions.docs: Get the range that we should be evaluating

functions.name: GetFrameNumberRange
functions.docs: Get the range of frame numbers traversed over this evaluation range, not including partial frames

functions.name: GetTraversedFrameNumberRange
functions.docs:
Get the range of frame numbers traversed over this evaluation range by flooring the lower bound, and ceiling the upper bound.
For example: a time range of [1.5, 5.6] will yield the equivalent of [1, 6). A time range of (2.0, 2.9) will yield the equivalent of [2,3).

functions.name: GetDirection
functions.docs: Get the direction to evaluate our range

functions.name: GetTime
functions.docs: Get the current time of evaluation.

functions.name: GetEvaluationFieldTime
functions.docs:
Get the current time to use for looking up within an evaluation field.
Subtly different from GetTime in that it returns the previous tick for exclusive boundaries

functions.name: GetDelta
functions.docs: Get the absolute amount of time that has passed since the last update (will always be >= 0)

functions.name: GetPreviousTime
functions.docs: Get the previous time of evaluation. Should not generally be used. Prefer GetRange instead.

functions.name: GetOffsetTime
functions.docs: Get the current time offset by the specified amount in the direction of play

functions.name: OverrideTime
functions.docs: Override the time that we're actually evaluating at

functions.name: GetFrameRate
functions.docs:
Get the framerate that this context's times are in
@return The framerate that all times are relative to

functions.name: ResetRange
functions.docs: Reset this range to a new range while retaining the current framerate and direction

functions.name: GetStatus
functions.docs: Get the playback status

functions.name: HasJumped
functions.docs: Check whether we've just jumped to a different time

functions.name: IsSilent
functions.docs: Check whether we're evaluating in silent mode (no audio or mutating eval)

functions.name: GetRootToSequenceTransform
functions.docs: Get the current root to sequence transform for the current sub sequence

functions.name: GetRootToSequenceWarpCounter
functions.docs: Get the current root to sequence warp counter for the current sub sequence

functions.name: GetSequenceToRootTransform
functions.docs: Get the inverse transform of the current sub sequence, to transform local times back to root times.

functions.name: GetSequenceToRootSequenceTransform
functions.docs: Get the inverse sequence transform of the current sub sequence, to transform local times back to root times.

functions.docs: Indicate that we've just jumped to a different time

functions.name: SetIsSilent
functions.docs: Set the context to silent mode

functions.name: Clamp
functions.docs: Clamp the current evaluation range to the specified range (in the current transform space)

functions.name: Transform
functions.signature: Transform(Target, In Transform, New Frame Rate)
functions.docs: Transform this context to a different sub sequence space

functions.name: SetHierarchicalBias
functions.docs:
Get the hierarchical bias for the current context
@param InHierarchicalBias		The current hierarchical bias

functions.name: GetHierarchicalBias
functions.docs:
Get the hierarchical bias for the current context
@return The current hierarchical bias

functions.name: IsPreRoll
functions.docs:
Check if we're in any kind of preroll (either prerolling section specifically, or as part of a sub-section)
@note Play direction has already been considered in the calculation of this function, so needs no extra consideration.

functions.name: IsPostRoll
functions.docs:
Check if we're in any kind of postroll (either postrolling section specifically, or as part of a sub-section)
@note Play direction has already been considered in the calculation of this function, so needs no extra consideration.

functions.name: HasPreRollEndTime
functions.docs:
Check whether we have an externally supplied time at which preroll will end.
@note When not set (and IsPreRoll() is true), preroll ends at either the start or end of section bounds, depending on play direction.

functions.name: HasPostRollStartTime
functions.docs:
Check whether we have an externally supplied time at which postroll started.
@note When not set (and IsPostRoll() is true), preroll ends at either the start or end of section bounds, depending on play direction.

functions.name: GetPreRollEndFrame
functions.docs:
Access the time at which preroll will stop, and evaluation will commence
@note: Only valid to call when HasPreRollEndTime() is true

functions.name: GetPostRollStartFrame
functions.docs:
Access the time at which post roll started (or in other terms: when evaluation stopped)
@note: Only valid to call when HasPostRollStartTime() is true

Reset this position to the specified time.
@note Future calls to 'PlayTo' will include this time in its resulting evaluation range
